doctrines.name: FedRAMP CR26 Audit Trail Destruction Block
doctrines.description: Blocks any attempt to destroy, wipe, or delete audit trail files including operations logs, vault databases, and ledger files

doctrines.name: FedRAMP AC-2 Unauthorized Resource Destruction
doctrines.description: Blocks destruction of cloud resources without explicit authorization tag in the command payload

doctrines.name: FedRAMP SI-4 Privilege Escalation via Cloud API
doctrines.description: Detects and blocks privilege escalation attempts through cloud API manipulation or IAM role assumption outside governed channels

doctrines.name: FedRAMP SC-8 Unauthorized Cross-Domain Data Transfer
doctrines.description: Blocks data transfers to endpoints outside the authorized cloud boundary without release authority approval

doctrines.name: FedRAMP CM-7 Unauthorized Configuration Change
doctrines.description: Blocks configuration changes to cloud resources that are not submitted through the governed operator channel
